lyrics:
The Lord hears the cry of the poor. Blessed be the Lord!

I will bless the Lord at all times, with praise every in my mouth. 
Let my soul glory in the Lord, who will hear the cry of the poor.

Let the lowly hear and be glad; the Lord listens to their pleas; and to hearts broken God is near , who will hear the cry of the poor.

Every spirit crushed God will save; will be ransom for their lives; will be safe shelter for their fears, and will hear the cry of the poor.
